category_edits.rationale: Scale input embeddings by fixed per-category training-frequency factors clip((median positive item count / item count)^0.1, 0.8, 1.2). This may reduce frequent-item dominance while preserving learned embeddings, GRU topology, candidate scoring, loss, and optimizer. Factors are checkpoint buffers; the generated predictor imports the updated model class and restores them through its existing state_dict loader.

item_counts = np.zeros(itemnum + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    for history in user_train.values():
        np.add.at(item_counts, np.asarray(history, dtype=np.int64), 1)
    observed = item_counts > 0
    observed[0] = False
    rarity = np.ones(itemnum + 1, dtype=np.float32)
    if observed.any():
        median_count = float(np.median(item_counts[observed]))
        rarity[observed] = np.clip(
            (median_count / item_counts[observed]) ** 0.1, 0.8, 1.2
        ).astype(np.float32)
    rarity[0] = 0.0
    with torch.no_grad():
        model.input_rarity.copy_(torch.as_tensor(rarity, device=device))
